meta.cash_movement_evidence_basis: Current-close cash-account journal rows are reconciled to the published cash-flow summary. Customer invoices and supplier accruals are analytical allocations of aggregate posted cash journals, not bank-matched remittances or invoice-level settlements. CAPEX SPEND ties to posted project journal IDs; GO_LIVE transfers are non-cash.

commentary.headline: Revenue increased 20.7% YoY
commentary.detail: Revenue changed by EUR 6.6m and EBIT by EUR 1.1m versus 2025-10.

commentary.headline: Hardware is the largest EBIT contributor
commentary.detail: Hardware generated EUR 3.9m EBIT in the month; Events is the lowest contributor at EUR 1.4m.

commentary.headline: Net working capital is EUR 50.0m
commentary.detail: DSO 48 days, DIO 55 days and DPO 60 days.

commentary.headline: Free cash flow is EUR 7.8m
commentary.detail: Cash generation is derived from customer collections, supplier payments, tax, interest and CAPEX rather than from a standalone cash assumption.

commentary.headline: Base forecast covers 12 forward months
commentary.detail: The current vintage is 2026-10 and includes explicit Upside and Downside scenarios plus historical bias correction.

performance_review.headline: Events mix reduced year-on-year revenue by €3.1m.
performance_review.explanation: The mix effect explains €3.1m of the revenue bridge versus the prior year. Price, volume and mix reconcile exactly to the reported revenue change.

performance_review.headline: Software OPEX was €37.7k above budget.
performance_review.explanation: Actual opex was €542.0k versus €504.3k budget. The variance represents 7.5% of the benchmark.

performance_review.headline: Events OPEX was €49.2k above budget.
performance_review.explanation: Actual opex was €1.0m versus €966.8k budget. The variance represents 5.1% of the benchmark.

performance_review.headline: Spare Parts OPEX was €19.3k above budget.
performance_review.explanation: Actual opex was €570.6k versus €551.3k budget. The variance represents 3.5% of the benchmark.

performance_review.headline: Software ebit missed budget by €42.2k.
performance_review.explanation: Actual ebit was €1.5m versus €1.5m budget. The variance represents 2.7% of the benchmark.

performance_review.headline: Hardware OPEX was €40.5k above budget.
performance_review.explanation: Actual opex was €2.3m versus €2.3m budget. The variance represents 1.8% of the benchmark.

performance_review.headline: Spare Parts mix reduced year-on-year revenue by €20.0k.
performance_review.explanation: The mix effect explains €20.0k of the revenue bridge versus the prior year. Price, volume and mix reconcile exactly to the reported revenue change.

performance_review.headline: FX translation reduced spare parts revenue by €14.8k.
performance_review.explanation: Reported performance differs from the close translated at prior-year FX by €14.8k. This is a translation view and does not represent a cash remeasurement gain or loss.

performance_review.headline: FX translation reduced spare parts ebit by €4.7k.
